nodes.author: iamDrBrijesh
nodes.text: @CNBCTV18Live This virus has been around globally for decades. It causes seasonal cold worldwide every year.

nodes.author: logicalvoter
nodes.text: @iamDrBrijesh @CNBCTV18Live Corona also existed for decades prior to pandemic. Mutations are the key.

nodes.author: iamDrBrijesh
nodes.text: @logicalvoter @CNBCTV18Live All such viruses undergo yearly and seasonal mutations. That's the nature of a virus. Hence u catch cold very frequently throughout your life

nodes.author: logicalvoter
nodes.text: @iamDrBrijesh @CNBCTV18Live Exactly my point. Just like corona certain mutations can make it more infective and higher mortality rate. It all depends on those factors. Just bcz it exists for decades is not a reason to trivialize it.

nodes.author: iamDrBrijesh
nodes.text: @logicalvoter @CNBCTV18Live So u want to go around creating panic about something that happens every year everywhere in the world. Even if u test it all across the country u will finds  thousands upon thousands cases. Some of them will be serious. It happens every year. Have u ever looked up data on this?

nodes.author: logicalvoter
nodes.text: @iamDrBrijesh @CNBCTV18Live Ya right. More testing is what's going to create panic. Being cautious is the key to fight any such infections. Trivializing or creating panic is not.

nodes.author: iamDrBrijesh
nodes.text: @logicalvoter @CNBCTV18Live For any one who thinks a novel thing is happening should visit any pediatrician's OPD at this time of the year. U will find halls packed with such cases
